Contour Asset Management Trimmed Stake in Nvidia (NVDA) by $13.86 Million; Speece Thorson Capital Group Increases Position in Idex (IEX)
June 25, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Contour Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Nvidia Corp (NVDA) by 24.39% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Contour Asset Management Llc sold 59,985 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.09% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 185,998 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $43.08 million, down from 245,983 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Contour Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Nvidia Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $152.33 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.40% or $6.16 during the last trading session, reaching $250.95. About 9.88M shares traded. NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) has risen 80.30% since June 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 67.73% the S&P500.
